oneOf.description:
The interface this connection's person uses. Send it once, after a host hello that
lists `surface::CAPABILITY`; an older host rejects the frame. The phone bridge
declares the phone itself and never forwards a phone's own declaration. A
connection that declares nothing is stamped as an unknown OX client.
Reserve a quiescent host until this same-user connection closes.
List the execution hosts linked to this host for a project. Answers WorkerReply.
Opt in to host-wide samples, including when no projects are open.

projects.description: Request the project directory without scanning session history. Requires project_directory.

terminal.description:
The client is a desktop window that can take a terminal handoff held for its
scope. Phones and other gateways never set it, and the web bridge refuses it.

oneOf.description: A same-user OX gateway that the host does not run asks it to own a worker.

Ask for the live processes the host runs. Answered by `Server::Processes`.
Only clients that send this receive that frame, so older clients are unaffected.
The parent-agent tools of such a gateway.

Decision.description: How a child's starting mode was decided. Recorded in its origin stamp.

oneOf.description: The receiving host set the starting level within the caller’s ceiling.
The source's level, mapped to the target runtime.
The launcher asked for a lower level.
An operator chose this level in a client sheet.
Use the highest available level allowed under the request or runtime.

Earlier.description: An earlier session in a handoff chain, readable through read_ox_thread.

ExternalCaller.description:
A worker gateway the host does not run, such as `ox claude` in a terminal.
The host can verify only the OS user. `launch` is a random token private to
that gateway; the host keeps only its digest. `session` is the native session
the gateway has observed, from its resume arguments or the stock client's own
MCP request metadata.

HandoffPage.description: A position in the conversation selected by the operator for a handoff.

HandoffSource.description: Where a handoff came from. Stored in the target's origin stamp.

history_broker.description: Digest of the desktop relay key for this destination pairing.

native.description: The source's native session ID, when it differs from the host ID.

source_access.description: The source's confirmed mode when the handoff started.

HandoffStart.description: An operator's request to continue a session elsewhere.

model.description: An OX API alias, or none for the runtime's native account.

yolo_confirmed.description: The client showed the YOLO confirmation for this start.

HandoffTransfer.description:
Selected, attributed context for an operator moving a conversation between
two paired hosts. Project paths in the source stamp are source-local.

id.description: Stable across host restarts. Legacy hosts supply only version and epoch.

oneOf.description: A command or tool result as short attributed text.

Level.description: Ordered permission levels. `Ord` is "more permissive than".

oneOf.description: Reads the project. Anything else asks a person.
Edits the workspace without asking about each edit.
A classifier reviews actions instead of a person.
Nothing reviews actions.

ModeRequest.description:
What a launcher asks for. `Inherit` is the default. On the wire it is a
string: `inherit`, a level name or a native preset name.

Omitted.description: A run of consecutive source items that were not carried.

ParentCall.description:
The only operations a parent agent has on its workers. Permission changes
belong to the human operator and have no variant here. A parent answers a
worker's approval or question only where the host's policy lets it stand in
for the operator.

oneOf.description:
Answer one open request of the worker: `choice` picks one of its listed
choices, `answers` fills its questions in order.

Read this session's own handoff sources, read-only. `session` names a
source in the caller's chain; absent means the nearest one. Pages by item
ID: `after` starts after that item, `item` returns one item in full.

Sent by a terminal gateway, never by the agent: the gateway observed its
own native session. The host records it once on the launch's workers so
a later resume of that session can reach them.

ProcessView.description:
One live process the host runs for a project and billing route.

A Claude process serves one thread. A Codex app-server serves a scope and lists
every thread subscribed on it. To end a process, send `Action::EndSession(thread)`
for each id in `threads` (scoped to `scope`). The host refuses `EndSession` on a busy
thread; `Action::ForceEndSession(thread)` ends it anyway, after the user confirmed.

draft.description:
The blank process kept warm for new sessions (the sign-in and version probe), not a
conversation. `kind` stays `claude`. End all idle skips it, since it respawns.

kind.description: `antigravity`, `claude`, `codex` or `worker` (every thread of the last kind is host-owned).

last_activity.description: Unix seconds of the last event or action on any of its threads.

route.description: The scope's billing route label, such as the model alias.

running.description: A turn is in progress or an approval is pending, so ending would lose work.

started_at.description: Unix seconds when the host started or first saw the process.

ProjectCheckout.description: Operator-visible checkouts. The path belongs to the reporting host.

ProjectQuery.description: A checkout query revalidates a specific known path after a user selects it.

SelectionRefs.description: References to a selection. This, never message text, is what the stamp keeps.

attachments.description:
Attachments in the source items (carried or omitted). They are never
carried as content, only named by path in the message text.

cut.description: Carried items that were cut. Their full text is in the source.

earlier.description:
When the source itself was a handoff target: its own sources, nearest
first. read_ox_thread reads them; their messages are not carried again.

includes_plans.description: The selection and its source IDs include visible plans.

stripped.description:
The source's first user item, whose carried context block was stripped
to its request.

total.description: Source items considered (after dropping reasoning and internals).

host.description: The host's build version and boot epoch. Older hosts omit it.

oneOf.description: The live processes of this host, newest first by start. Answers `Client::ListProcesses`.

SourceHost.description: A host-local session or path is meaningful only on its owning machine.

Surface.description:
The interface a person is using. Declared by the desktop for itself, and by the
authenticated phone bridge on behalf of the phone.

WorkerNeeds.description: Minimum installed hardware. Available memory and load rank eligible machines.

WorkerStart.description: An operator's request to start a worker attached to a session in the subscribed scope.

checkout.description: Execution directory, independent of the parent session identity.

host.description: A paired worker host name or stable ID. Omit to run on the parent's host.

max_minutes.description: Wall-clock limit in minutes. Absent means no limit unless the host sets `OX_WORKER_MAX_MINUTES`.

permission.description: The requested permission mode. Wins over `write`. Absent means inherit.

subscription_model.description:
An exact Claude subscription model to pin before the first inference,
such as `claude-fable-5-2`. Needs a Claude worker without an API alias.
The host refuses the launch when the account's picker does not offer it.

write.description: Legacy access request: false is read, true is write. Absent means inherit.

yolo_confirmed.description: An operator start whose client showed the YOLO confirmation.
